completed_chunks.style_note: Rue Cler already had 39 beats from books — only 1 wiki beat added (General Cler / Battle of Magenta) from FR wiki, since no EN wiki article exists. Place des Abbesses sourced from two articles: Abbesses station (Guimard édicule transferred from Hôtel de Ville 1974 + Nord-Sud anachronism, deepest until 2025) AND Saint-Jean de Montmartre (first reinforced concrete church in France, 1898 lawsuit + garden demos). Luxembourg Gardens story arcs: Medici Fountain journey, Carpeaux Four Continents fountain, first public museum 1694. Palais du Luxembourg: Chalgrin destroys Rubens gallery 1799-1805, Delacroix Inferno library ceiling, Choltitz surrender + first Provisional Assembly Nov 7 1944. Institut de France: Mazarin inscription, five académies, President as Protector.
